## Execution tips

- Consider closing the right gripper and contacting a flatter lid region with downward fingertips, keeping contact within the lid outline. Avoid open fingers spanning beyond the lid or entering the gap between upper and lower shells.
- Near the lid, use small vertical downward movements to reduce sideways contact. After contact, use live feedback to judge the response instead of continuing to press until visible deformation occurs.
- When adjusting the right gripper pose, leave clearance from the orange bin at the upper left of the stapler in the image and the fries box at the upper right, avoiding brushing them as the fingers rotate or open.
